about.title: How I Work
about.subtitle: I bring structure and reliability to complex operational systems.
about.paragraph1: I'm a software and DevOps engineer who turns manual, error-prone operations into automated systems—cutting delivery time and reducing production risk. At AssetWorks, I work with the hosting team on infrastructure that supports customer environments in production.
about.paragraph2: Much of my work begins with a process burdened by manual steps: provisioning a VM, verifying an environment after maintenance, comparing configuration across servers, or confirming that data reached the reporting layer correctly. I convert those processes into workflows, pipelines, and checks that run consistently and at scale.
about.paragraph3: I also work extensively on the infrastructure side of engineering—Kubernetes, AWS, Linux, networking, containers, observability, and CI/CD. When incidents occur, I focus on root-cause analysis and building safeguards against recurrence. I'm also fluent in AI-assisted development tools, which I use to ship tested, maintainable code faster.

experience.title: Where I've worked
experience.subtitle: Three internships across DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and software engineering.

assetworks.title: DevOps Intern
assetworks.description: Working with the hosting team on production infrastructure and customer environments. Built an end-to-end VM provisioning workflow with ManageIQ and embedded Ansible, reducing provisioning from a previous 7-day process to approximately 14 minutes. Scaled automated synthetic and sanity validation from 3 customers to 175+ environments and built configuration-driven maintenance workflows.

epilogue.title: DevOps Engineer Intern
epilogue.description: Worked on AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, including EKS, Docker, NGINX Ingress, ALB, HPA, rolling deployments, EC2, and VPC security. Built Airflow pipelines for millions of multi-service logs per day, added anomaly detection and Grafana visibility, and reduced AWS CloudWatch spending from $700 to $450 per month.

techavidity.title: Software Engineer Intern
techavidity.description: Built features for a full-stack SaaS application using React and TypeScript. Developed reusable components, testing and CI/CD workflows, and integrated Neo4j graph algorithms that reduced patient referral processing time by 25%.
